aboutText: With over 30 years experience, Raco Home Improvements brings passion and excellence to home renovations in Bundoora. We specialise in bathroom makeovers, kitchen renovations, and general improvements, working closely with you to make your vision come alive. No job is too small for us, and we pride ourselves on personalised service.
servicesText: We provide a wide range of services including bathroom renovations, kitchen makeovers, painting, tiling, and general home repairs. Our team is dedicated to quality workmanship and personalised service for every project in Bundoora and surrounds.
